name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations & Lifecycle Execution | Email, SMS, Landing Pages, QA & Automation
summary: Marketing operations professional who takes lifecycle campaigns from request to launch: building email and SMS journeys, landing pages, and automated workflows, checking the details, and reporting what worked. Built and deployed 20+ automated lifecycle workflows in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, hands-on in Marketo and Mailchimp, and runs projects in Asana, Jira, and ClickUp. Builds AI-assisted workflows and grades their output before anything goes out. Channel sales experience with agencies serving healthcare clients.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built and deployed 20+ automated lifecycle workflows in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including email and SMS onboarding, appointment reminders, reactivation, and review-request journeys.
Build landing pages and forms, write member-friendly copy, and create reusable templates adapted to each client's brand.
Break down manual marketing workflows into AI-assisted processes, grading AI output against rubric criteria before it reaches customers.
Track engagement and conversion in GA4 and CRM reporting, and adjust content and timing based on results.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced email sequences, landing pages, and conversion copy, ran A/B tests, and summarized performance and recommendations in QBRs.
Coordinated campaign execution across internal departments for multi-stakeholder accounts.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners, including agencies serving healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94%), and built automated training sequences for partners.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Managed client workflows and tasks in ClickUp at a performance marketing agency, building processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Coordinated 25+ client launches per month against a launch process, delivering on time at 110% of implementation targets, and led a team of onboarding specialists (20, later 8).
